translations.web: “Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
translations.bsb: Cursed is the one who is remiss in doing the work of the LORD, and cursed is he who withholds his sword from bloodshed.
translations.kjv: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
translations.asv: Cursed be he that doeth the work of Jehovah negligently; and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
